# Dashboardproducts wrongly uses NULL default Category

The Dashboardproducts native module always uses `NULL` as the default Category for products, because of a silent bug only revealed by PHP warnings.

Within early PrestaShop 1.7
```none
PHP Warning: Illegal string offset 'id_category_default'
```
- After @Progi1984  's Patch https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blame/21aa4c7d00b66aef61ca37494e63403ad6e79f9c/classes/Product.php#L7852
```none
PHP Warning:  Trying to access array offset on value of type int
```

The fallback value after the warnings is always `NULL` and it is used to construct the default `new Category` object in the Dashboardproducts module.

## Attendu
`Product->getDefaultCategory` may return either a string, an int or an array with an `id_category_default` key, when SQL value is found \(due to another bug in `ProductCore->getDefaultCategory` which uses `Db::getInstance()->getValue` and proceeds like it would return a result array from PDO or MySQLI.

Due to the upstream core bug in the `Product->getDefaultCategory`, the returned value has to be checked for type and handled accordingly. \(_to maintain backward compatibility with the Core bug and plan forward compatibility for when the Core bug patch PrestaShop/PrestaShop#31752 can be merged_).
